qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the battery positive connection point in the power distributor?
What torque should be applied to the wiring harness connection on the distributor?
Which component reference number corresponds to the battery positive connection point in the power distributor?
What screw size is used for both starter wire connections listed in section 12.42?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 screws are used for both connections.

qa_pairs.question: How much more torque is required for the battery positive connection compared to the wiring harness on distributor?
qa_pairs.answer: The battery positive connection requires 10 Nm more torque (20 Nm vs 10 Nm).

qa_pairs.question: What section number covers the wires to starter specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 12.42 covers wires to starter specifications.

qa_pairs.question: Which component has the higher torque specification in the starter wiring section?
qa_pairs.answer: The battery positive connection point in power distributor (1AZ) has the higher torque specification at 20 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What unit of measurement is used for all torque values in this section?
qa_pairs.answer: All torque values are measured in Nm (Newton-meters).

qa_pairs.question: Under which main section does the Engine Electrical Equipment fall?
qa_pairs.answer: Engine Electrical Equipment falls under section 12-10.
